error.title: Unable to reach Pixel EDM
error.description: Please try again shortly. If the issue persists, check your account status and database connection.

guide.adminOnlyDetail: This step requires an admin. Return to the checklist to see tasks available for your role.

store.title: Set up sender details
store.detail: Save your store name and physical footer address, then connect a primary sending channel. Sign-off name is recommended.

channels.title: Connect & verify primary channel
channels.detail: Save your channel settings, then ask an admin to send a test email. Provider acceptance does not guarantee inbox placement or reads.

contacts.title: Prepare subscribed contacts
contacts.detail: Review import results and consent records. Adding or importing a contact does not automatically mark them as subscribed.

templates.title: Prepare email content
templates.detail: Customize a starter template, preview it, and save. You will still verify variables and recipients inside each campaign.

campaigns.title: Create & review first campaign
campaigns.detail: Create a draft → preview emails & recipients → confirm the audience. Formal sending still requires explicit admin confirmation.
